mechanics.claim: Enemy damage applies life steal at 100% effectiveness.

mechanics.claim: Applies on-hit effects against champions and turrets hit, and triggers on-attack effects against one champion hit.

mechanics.claim: Applies spell damage to the same champion it applies on-attack effects to, and area damage to all other targets.
